remaining_gaps.detail: Original Microsoft Tahoma and Trebuchet MS remain unavailable to Fontconfig. Local Proton Tahoma copies are Wine replacements, not verified Microsoft originals. Fallback fonts remain in previews.
Native Plasma uses a hidden-items popup; original XP expands its notification area inline. This audit checks the visible tray components, not equivalent overflow behavior.
Original screenshot establishes one frame. The Plymouth strip movement is reconstructed; its timing and all palette phases are unverified.

Verified original menu icons are preferred when built from user archives. Windows Catalog and other unmapped artwork still use theme approximations. Boot footer typography depends on local fonts. Program names and user pictures are sample content.
Hover/pressed showcase variants are rendered; original screenshots do not cover every component in every state. No universal exact-match claim is supported.
